cities.name: Helsinki
cities.local_food_tip: Warm Nordic dishes like soups, veggie stews, rye bread sandwiches, cinnamon pastries and berry desserts — jednostavno, prirodno i jako ukusno.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌊 Helsinki Waterfront: Calm seaside walk. → ⛪ Helsinki Cathedral (Exterior). → ☕ Cozy Nordic café.

Afternoon: 🎨 Design District (Exterior). → 🌿 Esplanadi Park. → 🍽️ Lunch: Soups, rye bread, veggie stews. → 🏛️ Oodi Library (Exterior modern landmark).

Sunset: 🌅 Observatory Hill viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 Market Square lights + dessert cafés.
public_transport_tips: 🚲 City bikes are easy to use.
📱 Use 'HSL' app for routes and tickets.

city_events.name: Helsinki Festival
city_events.description: 🎭 Art, music and city-wide cultural events.

cities.name: Espoo
cities.local_food_tip: Light Nordic meals: soups, veggie dishes, pastries and berry treats.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🌿 Nuuksio National Park (Exterior trails). → ☕ Forest café.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Espoo Museum of Modern Art (Exterior). → 🍽️ Lunch: Soups, salads. → 🌊 Tapiola lakeside walk.

Sunset: 🌅 Lakeshore reflections.

Night: 🌃 Quiet modern-center lights.

cities.name: Oulu
cities.local_food_tip: Nordic soups, salads, berry pastries and veggie-friendly meals.

Afternoon: 🌿 Hupisaaret Islands Park. → 🍽️ Light lunch. → 🏞️ River paths.

cities.name: Rovaniemi
cities.local_food_tip: Warm soups, veggie stews, rye bread and berry desserts — ideal for cold weather.

Afternoon: 🌿 Arktikum (Exterior). → 🍽️ Warm soup lunch. → 🏞️ Ounasvaara hill paths.

Sunset: 🌅 Arctic sunset glow.

Night: 🌃 Riverside lights + dessert.

cities.name: Tampere
cities.local_food_tip: Veggie-friendly soups, potato dishes, pastries and Nordic breads.

Afternoon: 🌿 Pyynikki Park (Exterior). → 🍽️ Lunch: Soups, salads. → 🗼 Pyynikki Tower exterior viewpoint.

Sunset: 🌅 Lakeshore.

Night: 🌃 River bridges + lights.

cities.name: Turku
cities.local_food_tip: Soups, rye bread, veggie stews, salads and pastries — simple and tasty.

Afternoon: 🏛️ Old Great Square. → 🍽️ Lunch: Nordic soups, salads. → 🌿 Parks along the river.

Sunset: 🌅 Aura riverside glow.

Night: 🌃 Calm streets + dessert stops.
